title: Friend, woman 40: ate shrimp, lips and face swelling, itchy

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We're at a restaurant, Golden Wave, 520 Clement Street. It's my friend, she's 40.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Tell me exactly what happened.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She ate some shrimp and now her lips and face are swelling up and she's really itchy all over.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She says her throat feels a little tight, but she's breathing.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Is she awake and talking normally?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, she's awake and talking, she's just scared.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She didn't know she was allergic to shellfish. This never happened before.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Keep her sitting upright.
